whatsappMessage:
Hi Team GameX Shoes,

I noticed your footwear store has a great physical location in Muhammadpur, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for footwear shoppers looking for new arrivals and store directions.

Maine aapke store ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp size/stock inquiry, new arrivals showcase, aur Google Maps directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/gamex

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi GameX Shoes team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke footwear store (GameX Shoes in Muhammadpur, Patna) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp stock inquiry and mobile-first product showcasing for your store in Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual footwear inventory, photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
